constants.247.8: vogelB, the same fit numerator. DECLARED and EXPORTED. The one published check anywhere in the property fits is 0.890 cP for fresh water at 25 C, and it is the only number in them that comes from outside the module
constants.140: vogelC, the same fit offset. DECLARED and EXPORTED
constants.1.8: TWO constants carry this value. salinityViscosityMultiplier, the relative viscosity rise per unit mass fraction of dissolved solids: DECLARED and EXPORTED. API_421.shortCircuitCustomaryMax, the top of the customary short-circuit band: DECLARED and EXPORTED
constants.700: brineDensitySlopeKgM3, the density rise per unit mass fraction. DECLARED and EXPORTED
constants.999: crudeReferenceWaterKgM3, the water the API gravity specific gravity is taken against. DECLARED and EXPORTED
constants.60: defaultNBins, the droplet grid. DECLARED and EXPORTED, and it MOVES THE ANSWER, which is why every return reports it back
constants.4: defaultSpanSigma, how far either side of the median the grid reaches. DECLARED and EXPORTED. The volume it truncates is reported as truncatedTailFraction and is checked against twice the cdf at the span edge, which is an identity and needs no source
constants.3: THREE constants carry this value. defaultSharpness, the reduced-efficiency exponent of the gravity and centrifugal devices: DECLARED and EXPORTED, worth many points of removal and with no source here. flotationCellDepthM, the default cell depth: DECLARED and EXPORTED, an input since FC7-0. gasRatioMax, the widest gas to water ratio the module will describe: DECLARED and EXPORTED
constants.2: TWO constants carry this value. interceptionSharpness: DERIVED, not chosen. Interception capture goes as the square of the droplet diameter, so the grade curve is an exponential in the square of the reduced size and the reduced-efficiency family at m equal to 2 has the same half point and the same leading power. maxTurndown, the multiple of design flow past which the hydrocyclone refuses: DECLARED and EXPORTED
constants.1.5: THREE constants carry this value. interceptionCoefficient, the Stokes-flow interception efficiency coefficient: DECLARED and EXPORTED, no source here. shortCircuitFDefault, the API 421 turbulence allowance: DECLARED and EXPORTED, customarily 1.3 to 1.8. The customary band is enforced as a warning and 5 as a refusal
constants.0.7: THREE constants carry this value. plateEfficiencyFactor, the fraction of a plate pack projected area that settles: DECLARED and EXPORTED, worth a large part of the pack answer and with no source here. linerLengthM, which sets the liner residence time: DECLARED and EXPORTED. trainSigmaDefault, the inlet spread the train assumes when the caller states none: DECLARED and EXPORTED
constants.0.035: linerDiameterM, the liner bore. DECLARED and EXPORTED. Both liner dimensions now move the cut size, one through residence time and one through the travel as well
constants.0.0006: designFlowPerLinerM3S, the flow one liner is rated at. DECLARED and EXPORTED, and it is what the whole envelope is measured in multiples of
constants.1000: gFieldAtDesign, the field one liner develops at its design flow. DECLARED and EXPORTED. The reported field is this times the square of min(turndown, 1.3), so it cannot exceed 1690 g
constants.0.5: FOUR constants carry this value. coreRadiusFraction, where the oil core sits as a fraction of the liner radius: DECLARED and EXPORTED, refused at or above one over the root of two because past that the median droplet starts inside the core. starvedTurndown, the bottom of the liner envelope: DECLARED and EXPORTED. filterLoadingExponent, how fast bed capture falls with loading rate: DECLARED and EXPORTED. sigmaCustomaryMin: DECLARED and EXPORTED
constants.1.3: TWO constants carry this value. overloadTurndown, the top of the liner operating envelope: DECLARED and EXPORTED, and it is the most consequential number in the module, because the field stops rising there and the cut carries the root of the overload as a shear penalty past it. API_421.shortCircuitCustomaryMin: DECLARED and EXPORTED
constants.1.2: flotationGasDensityKgM3, the gas in the bubbles. DECLARED and EXPORTED, and an INPUT since FC7-0: it used to be a hardcode no caller could pass
constants.300: bubbleMicronDefault. DECLARED and EXPORTED. A 300 micron bubble rises at Reynolds about 20, which is why the bubble rise is the full drag balance and not Stokes
constants.0.2: TWO constants carry this value. gasRatioDefault: DECLARED and EXPORTED. gasHoldupWarn, the holdup past which a swarm of independent bubbles is no longer what is in the cell: DECLARED and EXPORTED
constants.20: TWO constants carry this value. bubbleMicronMin: DECLARED and EXPORTED. filterReferenceDropletMicron, the droplet the bed filter coefficient is declared at: DECLARED and EXPORTED
constants.0.01: attachmentEfficiency. A CALIBRATION and HELD FOR LITERATURE: the probability a collision sticks, chosen so a cell at this module's own defaults cuts in the range induced gas flotation is customarily credited with. It is the ONE number in the module with no derivation at all, it is an input so a caller with a vendor curve can move it, the jest suite PINS it rather than validating it, and NO GRADED CAPSTONE ANSWER IN THIS COURSE DEPENDS ON IT
constants.100: THREE constants carry this value. coarseCutWarnMicron, the cut past which the module says a flotation cell is doing very little: DECLARED and EXPORTED. apiGravityMax: DECLARED and EXPORTED. waterDensityMaxC, the top of the fresh water density fit: DECLARED and EXPORTED
constants.3.5: filterCoefficientPerM, the bed filter coefficient at its reference triple. DECLARED and EXPORTED. The triple of 3.5 per m at a 20 micron droplet, 800 micron media and 10 m/hr is ONE calibration of this module with no published source here
constants.10: filterReferenceLoadingMHr, the loading rate the filter coefficient is declared at. DECLARED and EXPORTED
constants.800: filterReferenceMediaMicron, the grain size it is declared at. DECLARED and EXPORTED. constants.25: filterBreakthroughLoadingMHr, the loading this module warns past. DECLARED and EXPORTED
constants.1: TWO constants carry this value. stokesReynoldsLimit, the Reynolds number Stokes law is stated to here: DECLARED and EXPORTED, and every device reports the Reynolds number of its own cut droplet against it. sigmaCustomaryMax: DECLARED and EXPORTED
constants.-10: waterViscosityMinC, the bottom of the viscosity fit band. DECLARED and EXPORTED, refused by name
constants.200: waterViscosityMaxC, the top of it. DECLARED and EXPORTED, refused by name

constants.5: TWO constants carry this value. apiGravityMin: DECLARED and EXPORTED. API_421.shortCircuitMax, past which the short-circuit factor is refused: DECLARED and EXPORTED

constants.0.158987294928: one barrel in cubic metres, EXACT by definition. The only unit conversion in the wave's own generators, used to turn a bwpd rate into m3/s the way the Suite layer does

plan.state: FOUNDATION COMPLETE at engines 8b8fb6a. Digest built, 22 sections. All 78 lessons writable. No lesson, bank, capstone answer file, panel, lab or migration written yet.
plan.thesis: Oil in water is a droplet size distribution and every device is a cut size, so what a train removes follows from the equipment's own geometry and the water's own properties, and the discipline is knowing which numbers on the page the engine DERIVED, which it was GIVEN, which it CALIBRATED and which it refuses to state at all.
plan.oneSentence: Produced Water Treatment teaches how to read oil in water as a droplet size distribution and every treating device as a cut size computed from its own geometry, so that what a train removes, what the water looks like afterwards, and what the engine will not rule on all follow from stated physics rather than from a quoted efficiency.

tiers.beginner: Associate. THE WATER, THE OIL, THE DROPLETS AND WHAT GRAVITY CATCHES. Why: this is the only part of the module that runs end to end in closed form, so a learner can watch a whole answer assemble before anything iterates, inverts or couples. It is also where the module's thesis first bites, because the temperature and the salinity the predecessor collected and ignored are exactly what set the viscosity and the density difference, and those set every cut size in the course. The gravity devices are the right first devices because their cut size is one inversion of one balance: the surface loading times an allowance. The tier ends at the point where a designer wants a finer cut than any plan area can buy.
tiers.intermediate: Professional. THE THREE DEVICES WHOSE CUT IS NOT GRAVITY ALONE. Why: each of the three answers the same question by a completely different argument, and a reader who can say which argument produced which number has the whole middle of this module. A hydrocyclone is a field and a travel, and it carries the sharpest engineering lesson in the course, because its operating envelope means the cut stops improving and starts degrading while the arithmetic of a bigger field would say otherwise. Flotation is a collision rate against a residence time, which is why the bubble size and the gas rate decide the answer and why a dissolved gas cell is a different device from an induced gas one. A media bed is an exponential penetration through a depth, and its cut size is an inversion of that rather than a second opinion about it. The tier ends able to put three unlike devices in a train and say why the order matters.
tiers.advanced: Expert. THE COUPLING, THE GRID, AND WHERE THE METHOD STOPS. Why: the two things left are the ones that separate a model from a lookup table. The coupling is why three good devices are not one great one, and it can only be seen by carrying the outlet distribution forward, which is what this engine does and what a fixed efficiency cannot. Then the honesty: the grid the medians are measured on, the creeping flow band the rise velocities are stated in, the difference between a refusal, a withheld verdict and a warning, the six things held for literature, and what an independent oracle is. This module's oracle is the strongest teaching example in the package, because it reaches the same answers by force balances, marched trajectories, bisections and 400,000 tracked droplets, and never types the constant the engine could have got wrong.

lessonLength.band: 420 to 560 words, ranked by est_minutes within a tier
lessonLength.measure: PROSE WORDS ONLY, counted the way lengths.py counts them: front matter, markdown table rows, headings and {{panel:...}} lines are all excluded. A raw wc -w over the whole file is NOT this measure and runs materially higher, so a lesson can be inside the band and still fail a raw word count. capstones.beginner: OGULAGHA, a gravity front end on a warm saline stream: the water viscosity, the brine density, the crude density, the median droplet rise velocity, the API 421 basin cut and the plate pack cut.
capstones.intermediate: IZOMBE, a de-oiling train on a cool very saline stream: the liner turndown, the centrifugal field at its ceiling, the cyclone cut with its shear penalty, the bubble rise velocity, the gas holdup and the bed cut.
capstones.advanced: TUNU, a three stage train on a hot fresher stream: the truncated tail of the grid, the plate stage removal, the cyclone stage removal, the train outlet concentration, the outlet droplet median and the Reynolds number of a coarse droplet outside the creeping flow band.
capstones.heldItemCheck: Every held item is neutralised BY CONSTRUCTION and every neutralisation is ASSERTED against the engine's own return values by fc7_capstone.mjs, which writes nothing if one fails. 28 such statements pass on every run. The basin runs under the fixed velocity limit and its warning is asserted null. Both graded beds are packed at the 800 micron reference grain, where the held grain exponent multiplies by one. No graded field reads a flotation cut, and the generator MEASURES that ten times the attachment efficiency moves the cut and leaves the bubble rise and the holdup identical to the last bit. The TUNU train is given no floor and no spec, and meetsSpec, marginPpm, dissolvedOilFloorPpm and floorApplied are all asserted to be withheld or absent.
capstones.tolerances: Derived, never typed, and in ONE PLACE from the first day of the wave: src/components/course/panels/producedwater/gradedTolerance.js holds the class and the stated tolerance of each field and derives the rest, and the capstone generator, the panel guard and the lab all import it. tol = max(stated, half a unit in the last place the digest prints that class), MAX AND NEVER MIN. Three of the eighteen are widened by that rule, the three dimensionless ratios from 1e-9 to 5e-7, and --bare-stated-tolerances is the negative control that restores the stated figures and makes the generator exit 1 naming all three. precision.json is DERIVED from the same table, so gradeprecision reads 18 OF 18 CLASSIFIED.
